usage: worklane.py [-h] [--repo REPO] [--project PROJECT] [-t TITLE]
                   [-d DESCRIPTION] [--draft | --shaping]
                   [--harness {codex,opencode}] [--model MODEL]
                   [--worker-harness {,codex,opencode}]
                   [--worker-model WORKER_MODEL]
                   [--reviewer-harness {,codex,opencode}]
                   [--reviewer-model REVIEWER_MODEL]
                   [--finalizer-harness {,codex,opencode}]
                   [--finalizer-model FINALIZER_MODEL] [--workers WORKERS]
                   [--effort {low,medium,high,xhigh}] [--interval INTERVAL]
                   [--once] [--now] [--refresh REFRESH] [--no-color] [--raw]
                   [--version]
                   [{run,start,check,board,status,logs,tui,config,pause,resume,stop,retry,add,stack}]
                   [number]

Configurable workers and one independent reviewer for a GitHub project board.

positional arguments:
  {run,start,check,board,status,logs,tui,config,pause,resume,stop,retry,add,stack}
                        Command to run; board opens the project board in your
                        browser (default: tui)
  number                Issue number for retry or logs

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           Local repository checkout (default: current directory)
  --project PROJECT     GitHub board OWNER/NUMBER; auto-detected when
                        unambiguous
  -t, --title TITLE     With add: new issue title (required)
  -d, --description, --body DESCRIPTION
                        With add: issue description (default: empty)
  --draft               With add: use the board's Draft status
  --shaping             With add: use the board's Shaping status
  --harness {codex,opencode}
                        Default harness (default: codex)
  --model MODEL         Default model override (Codex: gpt-6.1-sol; OpenCode:
                        configured default)
  --worker-harness {,codex,opencode}
                        Harness override for worker; empty inherits default
  --worker-model WORKER_MODEL
                        Model override for worker
  --reviewer-harness {,codex,opencode}
                        Harness override for reviewer; empty inherits default
  --reviewer-model REVIEWER_MODEL
                        Model override for reviewer
  --finalizer-harness {,codex,opencode}
                        Harness override for finalizer; empty inherits default
  --finalizer-model FINALIZER_MODEL
                        Model override for finalizer
  --workers WORKERS     Concurrent coding workers (1 to 16; default 3); one
                        independent reviewer
  --effort {low,medium,high,xhigh}
                        Reasoning effort (default high)
  --interval INTERVAL   Polling seconds (minimum 10; default 60)
  --once                Dispatch one batch, wait for it, then exit
  --now                 With stop: terminate active agents as well
  --refresh REFRESH     TUI refresh seconds (0.1 to 60; default 1)
  --no-color            Disable TUI colours
  --raw                 With logs: include protocol events and MCP diagnostics
  --version             Show installed CLI version, source path and revision,
                        then exit
